text:
ashley: Huge thanks to @ops and @infra for pulling an all-nighter to unstick the dedupe job and for bringing homemade lemon scones to the office this morning :sparkles: Honestly saved our demo. Big love! :heart:

sam: Those scones were legendary. also thanks to @kevin for the quick rollback plan :raised_hands:

jonah: Shoutout to the infra crew — the `rollback -> canary -> patch` sequence you ran was smooth. Watched the logs, impressive timing.

maria: @ashley you brought coffee too? 10/10 pairing. :coffee:

kevin: Glad it helped! Quick note for the runbook: I updated the cleanup commands under the incident section — use `./scripts/cleanup.sh --force` if the job is stuck more than 5min.

ops-bot: Incident #4487 closed by kevin — auto-note: postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-30 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

sam: Can we put a small kudos in the weekly update? ops + infra deserve it.

ashley: Yes please, adding a line now. Also I owe everyone leftover scones in the kitchen fridge — help yourselves :cookie:

jonah: :trophy: Teamwork + carbs = unstoppable

maria: Thanks again y'all, made our call look like a miracle. :sparkles:
